crossRefs.note: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
(In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is…
He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

translations.web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
translations.bsb: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
translations.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
translations.asv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
